<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court Oversight:</strong> The Centre has moved the Supreme Court to transfer all cases against Anil Ambani to the Delhi High Court, while the Court has halted Assam’s teacher appointments and is considering a pan-India safety audit for hostels following a building collapse.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxNSm9JbE51RUVRRWl3TzAzMzFtbDR1QTFDWUNTYTNZRnZpWFFxTmRxUEcwMzBTMEsxeDNUNUJINi1DemFnbFFST2VLbkFKRUp5MkZWWktEZ3ZLZHNYS21rOURTdUpybS10ZUFCQjVEaHE2M3VhMnVjYzdmenl6eUNMSWo3YmY5bnB4MWRmSEVVN1Q?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Corporate Tax Ruling:</strong> The Supreme Court dismissed a Rs 3.63 billion GST demand appeal against Vodafone Idea concerning the sale of its tower business.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxNSm9JbE51RUVRRWl3TzAzMzFtbDR1QTFDWUNTYTNZRnZpWFFxTmRxUEcwMzBTMEsxeDNUNUJINi1DemFnbFFST2VLbkFKRUp5MkZWWktEZ3ZLZHNYS21rOURTdUpybS10ZUFCQjVEaHE2M3VhMnVjYzdmenl6eUNMSWo3YmY5bnB4MWRmSEVVN1Q?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Governance Review:</strong> Prime Minister Modi held a review meeting with Union ministers focused on governance and policy implementation, notably excluding bureaucrats from the session.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
